help: Root of the shared project data archive, e.g. E:\projects\our_group\ai\project_data. Overrides FEWSHOT_DATA_ROOT.
Number of CPU workers, or 'auto'. Default is CONFIG n_jobs=2 / FEWSHOT_N_JOBS.
Disk mode: tiny, minimal, efficient, lean, balanced, or full. 'efficient' is recommended for final disk-efficient runs; 'compact' is an alias for lean.
RAM profile: ultra_light, light, standard, or normal.
Scientific breadth: smoke, quick, standard, or full.
Backward-compatible alias for --comprehensive-level quick.
Backward-compatible alias for --comprehensive-level smoke.
Ignore .done markers and recompute stages.
Reuse existing experiment metrics/predictions and rerun only aggregation, QC, candidate filtering, consensus tables, overlays, figures, and report.
Delete downstream .done markers so post-processing stages are regenerated without refitting models.
Rebuild the master table, useful after fixing RDF identifier merging. Does not delete completed experiment outputs by itself.
Comma-separated models allowed to nominate final candidates, e.g. rf,extra_trees,lightgbm,xgboost.
Do not filter candidate tiers by experiment quality/sanity gates. Not recommended for final shortlist generation.
Include RDFs.csv as an SI descriptor ablation if present. This can be large/slow.
Skip CoRE/MOSAEC external realism overlays even if files are present.
Comma-separated model list, e.g. ridge,extra_trees,hgb.
Comma-separated label budgets, e.g. 10,50,100,500.
Comma-separated random seeds, e.g. 42,43,44.
Comma-separated target names. Example: CO2_0p015bar_298K_mmolg,CO2_0p150bar_298K_mmolg
Comma-separated split names. Example: random,geometry_grouped,topology_grouped
Comma-separated feature sets. Example: geometry_only,geometry_plus_racs
